EX-99.1 2 tm2627720d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Quoin Pharmaceuticals Announces Publication of Peer-Reviewed Paper on QRX003 for Netherton Syndrome in Dermatology and Therapy – Peer-Reviewed Paper Introducing QRX003 and Its Mechanism of Action in Netherton Syndrome Now Published – Case Report Details 21 Months of Compassionate Use Treatment in a Pediatric Patient – Patient’s Skin Improved from Severe to Clear with Complete Elimination of Pruritus (itch) – After 21 Months of Treatment with QRX003, Patient’s Skin Remains Fully Clear and Pruritus Free – No Adverse Events have Been Reported for the Patient – Full Recruitment in Ongoing Phase 2/3 Netherton Syndrome Study Expected to Complete by End of 2026, with Topline Data Expected in Q2 2027 ASHBURN, Va., October 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
Separately, in August Quoin reported positive interim results from CL-QRX003-004, its ongoing Phase 2/3 study of QRX003 4% lotion in Netherton Syndrome.

In the interim analysis of the first six participants to complete 12 weeks of treatment, four of six (66.7%) achieved the primary endpoint of a 1-grade or greater improvement in Investigator Global Assessment (p=0.0087 vs. a pre-specified alpha of 0.0215).
Quoin expects to complete recruitment of all 20 participants in CL-QRX003-004 by the end of 2026 and report topline data in the second quarter of 2027.
This case report adds to a growing body of clinical evidence for QRX003, from our pediatric compassionate use program to the positive interim results from our ongoing Phase 2/3 study.
